title: One Armed Bandit
description:
Explore a weird casino, build your slot machine and punch enemies in the face!

One Armed Bandit is a "deck"-building roguelite where your combat actions are determined by the outcome of your (manually stopped) slot machine. Add more symbols to the machine to build incredible combos, get more items to grow stronger, play gambly minigames to get more stuff. 
Don't mess around for too long, the bouncers are coming to get you!

Features:• Unique slot-machine based combat

• 100 symbols to combo with each other

• Randomized map for a fresh challenge every time

• 3 minigames to waste your money on

• Dozens of enemies

• Flexible difficulty settings

• Excessive gambling and alcohol consumption

Remember, the house always wins!
description_short: Spin to win in this slot-machine-building roguelike! Collect symbols, items and chips, play risky minigames and build a rigged slot machine full of incredible combos! Progress through 3 varied chapters to "escape" the casino, then do it all over again
